title: Lakeside Boat Rental

services.name: Lakeside Boat Rental
services.desc: Complete your vacation with fishing boat rentals from Lakeside Boat Rentals. Aluma Craft and Polar Kraft boats are an excellent way to get out on the water affordably. Although these boats are as basic as they come, the memories you will make on them will last a lifetime. They are a great way to get into the tight spots to do some fishing where others can’t. They have seating for 3-6 people. These fishing boat rentals are the perfect way to get out there on a budget. Gaze at wildlife along the shore. Listen to the loon calls and anchor for a swim to enjoy Maine’s summer. Like to fish? Fish until your heart’s content. Instructions will be given to the driver until they feel comfortable

services.name: Pontoon Boat Rentals
services.desc: Bennington Pontoons are the leader of the pontoon boat market. Their quality and craft speak for themselves. These boats come with a boarding ladder, Bluetooth stereo, depth fish finder, cup holders, anchor, and all necessary safety equipment, including life jackets. Our pontoon boat rentals are the perfect way to complement your vacation. Start making memories now. Gaze at wildlife along the shore, listen to the loon call, and anchor for a swim to enjoy Maine’s summer. Instructions will be given to the driver until they feel comfortable taking the rental. We will make sure you know all the features of the boat and how it works. If something goes wrong, we have an emergency contact for you
